payload.title: Fix the four known file divergences in the parity lane
payload.description: tools/parity/known_divergences.txt still lists four file-level differences between kbs and kanbus: dependencies::file::project/issues/kbs-aa0002.json, init::file::.kanbus.yml, init::file::CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.template.md and update_comment_close::file::project/issues/kbs-aa0001.json. Make both runtimes write byte-identical files for these cases and empty the list; the lane then guards file fidelity (the golden cross-runtime test kbs-232185 asked for).
